items.title: John Best interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: And I was with Benny until he broke up the band in fourteen months.

ctx.x: ‘45. And I went back to North Carolina to see my mother for a couple of days or something. But I had the job with Benny, I think the 15th or something like that. And I was with Benny until he broke up the band in fourteen months. And I was very happy to

join that band after three years in the Navy. Because four of us went out of that band. The band, we were not all, they discharged — the married guys got out first, they had more points. So they didn’t know it but I was divorced at about that same time. If they’d have found out I’d probably still be in the Navy.
